The company

One Group, Two Operating Divisions

Pines Energy Group brings together two related operations under one company. Pines USA produces biodiesel blends derived from waste cooking oil. Pines Solutions handles oil recycling, collection, and cleaning.

Food service partners can arrange collection at their location or bring used cooking oil to Recovery Point in Athens. Fuel customers can contact Pines USA to discuss their requirements.

Introducing Recovery Point

A dedicated place for your used oil.

Built by Pines Energy Group and operated by Pines Solutions, Recovery Point gives food trucks and food service partners a fixed location to pump used cooking oil into secure storage for collection.
